Gordon Resting-State Cortical Parcellation

Source: R/data.R
gordon.Rd

Brain atlas for the Gordon cortical parcellation with 329 regions based on resting-state functional connectivity boundaries. Contains 2D polygon geometry for ggseg::geom_brain().

gordon()

Value

A ggseg.formats::ggseg_atlas object (cortical).

References

Gordon EM, Laumann TO, Adeyemo B, Huckins JF, Kelley WM, Petersen SE (2016). Generation and Evaluation of a Cortical Area Parcellation from Resting-State Correlations. Cerebral Cortex, 26(1):288-303. doi:10.1093/cercor/bhu239

Examples

gordon()
#> 
#> ── gordon ggseg atlas ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> Type: cortical
#> Regions: 332
#> Hemispheres: left, right
#> Views: inferior, lateral, superior, medial
#> Palette: ✔
#> Rendering: ✔ ggseg
#> ✔ ggseg3d (vertices)
#> ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#>    hemi    region        label
#> 1  left  L_None_1  lh_L_None_1
#> 2  left  L_None_2  lh_L_None_2
#> 3  left  L_None_3  lh_L_None_3
#> 4  left  L_None_4  lh_L_None_4
#> 5  left  L_None_5  lh_L_None_5
#> 6  left  L_None_6  lh_L_None_6
#> 7  left  L_None_7  lh_L_None_7
#> 8  left  L_None_8  lh_L_None_8
#> 9  left  L_None_9  lh_L_None_9
#> 10 left L_None_10 lh_L_None_10
#> ... with 322 more rows
plot(gordon())
